resources.title: Introducing System One Models & Jev

summary.en: The System One positioning, typed decisions, and vendor descriptions of sampling and RLCD.
summary.zh: System One 定位、类型化判断，以及官方对采样与 RLCD 的介绍。

scope.en: Architecture and training are vendor descriptions; workflow comparisons are vendor-reported.
scope.zh: 架构与训练来自官方介绍；工作流对照属于官方自测。

resources.source_snapshot: Official launch article dated 2026-09-15, fetched 2026-10-26

resources.title: TypeSafe Quick Start

summary.en: State, questions, and typed answers in one request.
summary.zh: 一次请求中的 State、Questions 与类型化响应。

scope.en: Use the current SDK/API documentation for actual integration.
scope.zh: 实际接入以当前 SDK/API 文档为准。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: State

summary.en: Build shared textual, structured, or image-referencing state for independent questions.
summary.zh: 为独立问题构造共享文本、结构化内容或图像引用状态。

scope.en: Same-request answers are not a sequential reasoning chain.
scope.zh: 同批问题的答案不构成顺序依赖链。

resources.source_snapshot: State documentation fetched 2026-10-26; image support checked against Images documentation on 2026-10-27

resources.title: Choice

summary.en: Choose among predefined candidates with an option distribution.
summary.zh: 从预定义候选中选择，并返回选项概率分布。

scope.en: Missing candidates cannot be recovered by the selector.
scope.zh: 选择器不能选出候选集中不存在的动作。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Score

summary.en: Evaluate an ordered set of levels rather than generate an explanation.
summary.zh: 在有序等级上作判断，返回等级分布与分数。

scope.en: Levels must describe one interpretable dimension.
scope.zh: 等级应表达同一个可解释维度。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Noul

summary.en: Return a probability for a yes/no proposition.
summary.zh: 对二值命题返回“是”的概率。

scope.en: Thresholds need task-specific validation; no separate native confidence field.
scope.zh: 阈值需按任务验证；原生响应没有独立 confidence 字段。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Confidence

summary.en: Explain how Choice and Score confidence is derived from their distributions.
summary.zh: 解释 Choice 与 Score 的 confidence 如何由概率分布计算。

scope.en: Distribution concentration does not guarantee factual correctness or task success.
scope.zh: 分布集中不保证事实正确或任务成功。

resources.source_snapshot: Official Confidence Markdown fetched 2026-10-27; Choice/Score formulas and derived Noul statistic checked

resources.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev

summary.en: Independent evaluation across 37 datasets, including accuracy, calibration, and selective prediction.
summary.zh: 覆盖 37 个数据集的独立评估，讨论准确率、校准和选择性预测。

scope.en: Preprint; conclusions depend on model version, prompts, baselines, and answer coverage.
scope.zh: 预印本；结论受模型版本、提示、基线与回答覆盖率约束。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Images: multimodal state and criteria

summary.en: Images in shared state, instructions, and answer criteria; Jev 1.13 and 1.14 support image input.
summary.zh: 图像进入共享状态、题干与候选；Jev 1.13 和 1.14 均支持图片。

scope.en: Experimental; requires the images header and documented image/request limits.
scope.zh: 实验能力；需启用图像请求头并遵守图像及请求大小限制。

resources.source_snapshot: Official Images Markdown fetched 2026-10-27

resources.title: Box: image localization

summary.en: Jev 1.14 returns one normalized target box per question, alongside confidence.
summary.zh: Jev 1.14 每题返回一个目标的归一化边界框及 confidence。

scope.en: Experimental; absent targets still produce boxes, so validate presence separately.
scope.zh: 实验能力；不存在的目标也会返回框，需另做存在性校验。

resources.source_snapshot: Official Box Markdown fetched 2026-10-27

resources.title: Can Jev See? A 48-image COCO evaluation

summary.en: Community comparison of image Noul, word/picture Choice, Score, and Box across two Jev versions.
summary.zh: 社区对照两个 Jev 版本的图像 Noul、文字／图片 Choice、Score 与 Box。

scope.en: 48 selected images, repeated calls and imperfect labels; author-reported, not a full COCO benchmark.
scope.zh: 48 张筛选图像、重复调用及不完整标签；作者报告，不是完整 COCO 基准。

resources.source_snapshot: Author report fetched 2026-10-27

resources.title: OpenJev

summary.en: Read and normalize candidate-token probabilities at diffusion answer slots using existing weights.
summary.zh: 使用现成权重，在扩散答案槽读取候选 token 概率并归一化。

scope.en: Independent implementation; grouping, rereads, and entropy confidence differ from official Jev.
scope.zh: 独立实现；问题分组、追加读取及熵置信度与官方 Jev 不同。

resources.source_snapshot: engine.py at b4339c640f5331ef75098637d1be2c787715ee88 fetched 2026-10-27

resources.title: Visual Jev: code and released adapter

summary.en: Qwen3-VL answer-SFT LoRA, existing LM-head readout, and shared visual-prefix batching.
summary.zh: Qwen3-VL 答案监督 LoRA、原 LM head 概率读出与视觉前缀共享批处理。

scope.en: Community model; quickstart supports Choice with 2–16 options, not the official multimodal API.
scope.zh: 社区模型；quickstart 支持 2–16 候选的 Choice，不等同官方多模态 API。

resources.source_snapshot: README, bottle question JSON, and 4B adapter model card fetched 2026-10-27

resources.title: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context

summary.en: Separates training accuracy gains from shared-image execution and amortized throughput.
summary.zh: 区分训练带来的准确率变化与共享图像计算带来的摊销吞吐量变化。

scope.en: Four forced-choice tasks, one backbone family, one timing machine; 5.7 ms/question is not request latency.
scope.zh: 四项候选选择任务、一个模型家族和单机计时；5.7 ms/题不是单次请求延迟。

resources.source_snapshot: Paper results cross-checked against author README/model card fetched 2026-10-27; not an independent rerun

resources.title: NanoJev

summary.en: Qwen3-0.6B and a shared decision head jointly trained for four games.
summary.zh: 共同训练 Qwen3-0.6B 与共享决策头，覆盖四款游戏。

scope.en: unified-games-v1 selects step 400; task-specific training and reported tests do not establish a general replacement.
scope.zh: unified-games-v1 选用第 400 步权重；专门训练与作者测试不证明通用替代能力。

resources.source_snapshot: README fetched 2026-10-27; unified-games-v1 / hard_lr1e5

resources.title: Contrastive Language Models (CLM)

summary.en: Frozen Qwen3-8B plus contrastively trained state/action projections and independently cached candidates.
summary.zh: 冻结 Qwen3-8B，对比训练状态／动作投影头，并独立缓存候选。

scope.en: Text encoder in reviewed release; visual support is roadmap work and reported speedups are task-specific.
scope.zh: 审阅版本为文本编码器，视觉支持仍属路线图；作者加速比受任务设置限制。

resources.source_snapshot: README fetched 2026-10-27; public method and evaluation descriptions

resources.title: jev-ultrafast

summary.en: Select browser operations and numbered DOM targets; use a separate generator for free text.
summary.zh: 选择浏览器操作与编号 DOM 目标，自由文本由辅助模型生成。

scope.en: One flight-search task and engineering timings do not establish cross-site reliability.
scope.zh: 单个航班搜索任务与工程计时不足以证明跨网站可靠性。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: typesafe-computer-use

summary.en: OCR and accessibility build state; Jev selects an action and target reference.
summary.zh: OCR 与辅助功能接口构造状态，Jev 选择动作和目标编号。

scope.en: Perception pipelines differ in the reported comparison; compare full-step and task costs.
scope.zh: 作者对照的感知链路不同，应比较完整单步及任务开销。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: fast-jev-compaction

summary.en: Use paired retention judgments to keep, truncate, or remove tool interactions.
summary.zh: 通过调用与结果的保留判断，对工具交互作保留、截短或删除。

scope.en: Concept animations and mock demos are not measurements of downstream task quality.
scope.zh: 概念动画与模拟演示不能作为后续任务质量的实测。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: jev-trader

summary.en: Study decision freshness in a continuous market-state and execution loop.
summary.zh: 研究持续市场状态更新与执行循环中的判断时效。

scope.en: The reviewed public demo is dry-run/mock; no live-profit claim.
scope.zh: 所审阅公开演示为 dry-run/mock，不构成实盘收益证据。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: NavJev

summary.en: Compress visual navigation into action-centered waypoint descriptions and history.
summary.zh: 将视觉导航压缩为以动作为中心的路点描述与历史。

scope.en: Reported 100-task simulation comparison; input design and non-reasoning baselines matter.
scope.zh: 作者报告的百任务仿真对照；需考虑输入设计与未开启推理的基线。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Can Jev Nav / Nav Arena

summary.en: Navigation actions from structured spatial state, with broad system comparisons.
summary.zh: 从结构化空间状态选择导航动作，并比较多套完整系统。

scope.en: Main evaluation, short-range subset, representation study, and real-robot demo are different sets.
scope.zh: 主评测、短程子集、状态表示实验和实机演示属于不同样本。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation

summary.en: Separate programmatic skill simulation from language-conditioned skill selection.
summary.zh: 将程序实现的技能模拟与语言条件下的技能选择分开。

scope.en: Changing torque to skills also changes control assistance; this uses a known simulator.
scope.zh: 从力矩改为技能同时改变控制辅助；所用预测来自已知仿真器。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: jev-libero

summary.en: Use short branch simulations to choose intent, action family, and atomic input.
summary.zh: 利用短时分支仿真，依次选择意图、动作类别与原子输入。

scope.en: Passing examples are not a standard LIBERO benchmark score or a learned world-model result.
scope.zh: 通过示例不等于标准 LIBERO 成绩，也不等于学习型世界模型结果。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: EmbodiedJev

summary.en: Combine visual planning with local direction and gripper decisions.
summary.zh: 将视觉规划与局部方向、夹爪判断组合。

scope.en: Small development runs; track object progress as well as end-effector motion.
scope.zh: 少量开发运行；应同时检查物体进展与末端运动。

resources.source_snapshot: Local source review at f08de2e4e20d6cd69fea9c57ac1062c3ef510f1e; linked upstream may evolve

resources.title: RoboJEV

summary.en: Two-stage intent and XYZ/gripper selection in MuJoCo manipulation.
summary.zh: 在 MuJoCo 操作任务中进行意图与 XYZ/夹爪两级选择。

scope.en: The reported rule baseline completes more tasks; whole-arm feasibility remains a control concern.
scope.zh: 作者报告中规则完成数更高；整臂可行性仍需控制层检查。

resources.source_snapshot: Local source review at 2c920c29e5e76cc57908b3c05907d7c5d91565c1; linked upstream may evolve

resources.title: RoboICL — Jev action-reuse study

summary.en: Decide whether to reuse the remaining action suffix or regenerate it.
summary.zh: 判断继续复用剩余动作，还是重新生成。

scope.en: Jev substudy: two development tasks, five layouts each; main-framework videos are separate.
scope.zh: Jev 子实验为两项开发任务、各五个布局；主框架视频应分开解读。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: GeoLingo (formerly DepthJev)

summary.en: Translate metric depth and object detections into text facts for Jev navigation decisions.
summary.zh: 将度量深度与目标检测结果转为文本事实，由 Jev 选择导航动作。

scope.en: Author-reported 300-episode EB-Navigation evaluation; target-type errors are prominent on visual-appearance tasks.
scope.zh: 作者报告的 300 回合 EB-Navigation 评测；视觉外观任务中的目标类型判断仍有较多错误。

resources.source_snapshot: GeoLingo README reviewed 2026-10-29; renamed from DepthJev. Results cover 300 EB-Navigation episodes, with target type correct on 25/60 visual-appearance cases.

resources.title: jev-robotic-arm-benchmark

summary.en: Compare Jev, a structured LLM selector, and rules through the same xArm interface.
summary.zh: 通过相同 xArm 接口比较 Jev、结构化 LLM 选择器和规则。

scope.en: Three nearby starts and 16 paired probes; API waiting pauses simulation.
scope.zh: 三个近邻初态与 16 对请求；API 等待时仿真暂停。

resources.source_snapshot: Published records at c1f19529198651cb066a6ad924a1b89cdd27be4d

resources.title: jev-arm-lab

summary.en: Study skill choice and the mismatch between grasp judgments and physical attachment.
summary.zh: 研究技能选择，以及抓稳判断与真实持有状态的偏差。

scope.en: Decision events within one episode are correlated, not independent task trials.
scope.zh: 同一回合内的判断事件相关，不能当作独立任务样本。

resources.source_snapshot: Published failure logs at 1c12c89d7b4d5ad3ad866fc05992caeffc1299c5

resources.title: Robots World

summary.en: Explore state aging, tracking, and feedback while the environment keeps moving.
summary.zh: 探索环境持续运动时的状态过期、追踪和反馈。

scope.en: Small trials and post-hoc criteria must remain distinguishable.
scope.zh: 小规模试验与事后判定标准需要明确区分。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: jev-drone

summary.en: Separate slower semantic decisions from faster flight control and constraints.
summary.zh: 将较慢语义判断与较快飞行控制、约束检查分层。

scope.en: Simulation; architecture frequencies are project settings, not general Jev guarantees.
scope.zh: 仿真项目；架构频率是项目设置，不是 Jev 的通用性能保证。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: jev-wam

summary.en: Propose choosing between plan reuse, observation, and expensive prediction.
summary.zh: 提出在计划复用、补充观察与昂贵预测之间选择。

scope.en: Design-stage material in the reviewed snapshot, without completed integration results.
scope.zh: 所审阅版本处于设计阶段，尚无完成集成后的效果结果。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: Awesome Closed-Loop VLA

summary.en: A three-loop framework for execution, prediction, and learning.
summary.zh: 执行、预测与学习三个闭环的统一框架。

scope.en: Conceptual connection; the surveyed methods do not all use Jev.
scope.zh: 概念关联；综述中的方法并非都使用 Jev。

resources.source_snapshot: README at cd9f6a93650192b1c0a9e40ee6ab2e634eb23d56

resources.title: Awesome World Model

summary.en: World-model foundations, executability, and evaluation resources.
summary.zh: 世界模型基础、动作可执行性与评测资源。

scope.en: Resource index; not a Jev world-model implementation.
scope.zh: 资源索引；不是 Jev 世界模型实现。

resources.source_snapshot: README at 457ec4665a88f4d8cd2ff2b1afd5ed94d3d2462e

resources.title: V-JEPA 2

summary.en: Action-conditioned latent prediction provides a reference for learned planning models.
summary.zh: 动作条件潜空间预测为学习型规划模型提供参考。

scope.en: No Jev integration is established by this paper.
scope.zh: 该论文没有验证与 Jev 的联合方案。

resources.source_snapshot: Public sources reviewed for the September–October 2026 research notes

resources.title: LIBERO

summary.en: Robot manipulation environment and task suites used by several examples.
summary.zh: 多个案例使用的机器人操作环境与任务套件。

scope.en: A custom task subset is not the official suite evaluation.
scope.zh: 自定义任务子集不等同于官方完整套件评测。
